title: 부재선고등에관한특별조치법시행령 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Issuance of Certificates of Persons Remaining in Unrecovered Areas)
(1) A person who wishes to obtain a certificate of a person remaining in an unrecovered area under Article 7 of the Act shall submit an application in the attached form (including an application in electronic-document form) to the provincial governor having jurisdiction over the place of the person's original family registry. [Amended on March 17, 2004.]
(2) A certificate concerning the family relationship registration records of the person remaining in an unrecovered area shall be attached to the application under paragraph (1). [Amended on November 2, 2010.]
